Soil-health scores

Source: R/health-read.R
soil_health_scores.Rd

Reads the soil-health scores published on horizons (POST /query/soil-health), page by page, as a typed table: one row per horizon, category and model version, with the score, its class and status, the model and the run that produced it.

Usage

soil_health_scores(
  soil = soil_session(),
  providers = NULL,
  datasets = NULL,
  release_ids = NULL,
  release_codes = NULL,
  model_versions = NULL,
  run_ids = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  score_classes = NULL,
  statuses = NULL,
  source_supports = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  depth_top_cm = NULL,
  depth_bottom_cm = NULL,
  with_geometry = c("none", "sf", "text"),
  include_details = FALSE,
  max_rows = Inf,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

providers

Provider codes. API field providers.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes. API field datasets.

release_ids, release_codes

Releases of the scored horizons. API fields release_ids and release_codes.

model_versions

Soil-health model version codes (an unknown code is refused by the API). API field model_versions.

run_ids

Product run ids (API field product_run_ids).

categories

Category codes ("physical", "chemical", ...). API field categories.

score_classes

Score classes. API field score_classes.

statuses

Score statuses: "scored", "insufficient_data", "not_applicable" (API field score_statuses).

source_supports

Source supports ("point_observation", "polygon_estimate", ...). API field source_supports.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names. API field country.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees. API field bbox.

depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm

Depth interval in cm: the horizons overlapping it. API fields depth_top_cm and depth_bottom_cm.

with_geometry

"none", "text" (the geometry of the feature as GeoJSON text in geometry_text) or "sf" (an sf object with a geometry column, EPSG:4326; needs the package sf, else a soilhub_dependency_error). Client-side; sets the API field include_geometry (false for "none"), the form is built locally.

include_details

Add the list columns inputs, derived_variables, memberships, activated_rules, diagnostics, input_observations (how each score was computed). API field include_details.

max_rows

Maximum number of scores to read (Inf: all). Client-side; caps the API field limit of each page request.

progress

Report the pages read. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A soil_table (see soil_table) with soil_layout = "health": horizon_score_id, value_id, variable_code, horizon_id, profile_id, component_id, feature_id, dataset_code, provider_code, release_id, release_code, source_support, geometry_kind, (geometry_text), horizon_key, horizon_name, top_depth_cm, bottom_depth_cm, model_version_id, model_version_code, model_name, model_checksum, health_run_id, product_run_id, category_code, category_name, score (double), score_class, score_status, created_at (POSIXct UTC), and the detail columns.

Details

Filters are combined with AND; each takes several values. NULL means no filter.

Rights: soil:read. Capabilities: query_soil_health; country_filtering for country.

See also

soil_health_summary(), soil_publish_health()

Other thematic reads: soil_health_summary(), soil_resolve_targets(), soil_ttr_flags(), soil_values(), soil_values_summary()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
h <- soil_health_scores(soil, datasets = "sotwis_polygons", country = "TUN",
                        categories = "physical", include_details = TRUE)
table(h$score_class)
} # }
